page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.9 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processor includes 48 MB of L3 cache and supports hardware-accelerated instructions such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, and SHA extensions. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.g7se.2xlarge in the average performance tier across most compute and memory workloads. The single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests yield scores of 1858.18 and 7750.15 respectively, while Geekbench 5 records a single-core score of 1517.0 and a multi-core score of 5658.0. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate read-only speeds of 422.95 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 58.09 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. However, database operations show some limitations, with Redis SET operations performing in the bottom 25% tier at 7.88 million operations per second. Large language model inference speeds are average for small 135M models but drop to poor or weak tiers for larger 7B models.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, representing standard cost efficiency for general-purpose workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The absence of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, requiring network-attached storage. The hardware profile and benchmark results indicate this instance is suited for general-purpose applications, static web serving, software compilation, and light text or image processing tasks.
